annotation.evidence_span: MUST NOT generate pseudo-header fields other than those defined in this document
annotation.interpretation_a: Endpoints are forbidden from creating any pseudo-header fields not explicitly listed in this document, even if they are logically consistent with existing ones.
annotation.interpretation_b: Endpoints can create pseudo-header fields as long as they do not conflict with the ones defined in this document, but are not formally standardized.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'other than those defined' is incomplete. It doesn't specify what constitutes a definition. Is merely listing a name sufficient, or must there be a complete specification of its semantics? This lack of precision allows for different interpretations of what is permissible.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not define what constitutes a conflict. Does a name collision constitute a conflict? Does a semantic overlap? Without this, implementations may differ on whether a new pseudo-header is permissible.
